wording.stamp: EXPLORATORY (FROZEN_RULES 6.R5.7; N2 spec Amendment 5). Gate tag HIDE_NOT_HUMAN_VALIDATED.
wording.n2_check: the scorer's hide/show call was checked on 6 N2 statements only (descriptive); not checked on newly generated text beyond 6 items
wording.gate: R5 status VALIDATED_PRESENCE: the scorer is validated for detecting whether a disagreement is present, not for detecting whether a statement hides it; the hiding measure E is not human-validated. Step-2 scope: the scorer's detection of disagreement was validated against participants' own pre-deliberation position ratings, for whether a group disagrees, not for whether a statement hides it.
wording.scope: five open-weight instruction-tuned models (8B-27B); statements are not ranked by humans: N2 says what models write, not what people reward
wording.self_scored: qwen3.8-27b text is scored by qwen3.8-27b (self-scored) everywhere
wording.a4: A4 = none (Amendment 4): no A4 robustness read, no generator x scorer interaction, no A4 agreement / zero-crux tables
wording.null: a CI that includes 0 is reported as 'CI includes 0; MDE (d_z, 80% power) at the effective n = ...', never as 'no effect' (the spec's 'not detected' is replaced because FR 6.R5.6 bars 'detected' for E-based results under VALIDATED_PRESENCE)
wording.between_generators: between-generator differences in the level of E are descriptive only and never attributed to family, size or release date

scorer: qwen3.8-27b (scorer 1, frozen v2) for all 5 generators

mixed_model_unadjusted.fitted_by: statsmodels MixedLM (REML; optimisers lbfgs, bfgs, cg tried in sequence): random intercept launch + variance component round within launch

mixed_model_adjusted.fitted_by: statsmodels MixedLM (REML; optimisers lbfgs, bfgs, cg tried in sequence): random intercept launch + variance component round within launch

ledger_rows.job: scorer N2 qwen3.8-27b v2 (6250 statements, 250 rounds; 6500 calls est.) ESTIMATE

exploratory_extra.note: wild cluster bootstrap-t intervals are under per_generator.*.sets.primary.exploratory_extra_wild_t

implementation_choices:
(the spec is silent; fixed here before any N2 score was read by this script's author):
  * Holm p-value = the FR s7 percentile-bootstrap p, 2*min(#{b<=0}+1, #{b>=0}+1)/(B+1), from the same launch resamples as the CI.
  * Holm is applied to the unadjusted and to the covariate-adjusted contrasts separately (both reported; neither preferred, spec 9/11).
  * Covariate adjustment of a paired contrast = intercept of the launch-clustered regression of the round-level difference d on the
    same linear combination of log(words) (centred within generator) and, if the generator has any preambled statement, of the
    preamble flag (FR N1's "intercept regression across rounds" form); the intercept is the contrast at equal length / preamble.
  * Manipulation check = ((SAT-COMMON + ACC-COMMON) - (SAT-DIS + ACC-DIS)) / 2 per round (same sign as the spec's sum form).
  * Section-6 system effect = ((SAT-COMMON - ACC-COMMON) + (SAT-DIS - ACC-DIS)) / 2 per round.
  * "flagged" = think-tag leak, refusal/meta, preamble or truncation (n2_grid regexes); exclusion drops the round for that generator.
  * Pooled mixed model: cell x generator means (25 columns) + log(words)_c x generator + preamble term(s); random intercept launch,
    variance component round within launch (statsmodels MixedLM, REML); fallback launch-cluster-robust OLS if it fails / does not converge.
